snippet.title: Northward - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://link.playnorthward.com/steampage

Northward is an open-world co-op adventure about sailing a scrappy ship through a northern archipelago, exploring the uncharted, hunting for lost treasure, and finding a way to return a fallen star home.

Play solo or with friends, upgrade your ship, gather resources and tools, recruit new crew-members, and uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization.

https://www.playnorthward.com/
